zh.title: 两名数字员工交报告，重启后补送哪份？
zh.summary: 同一张工单有两份报告，项目主管只确认了一份。三组重启对照表明，逐份回执可以让系统找回尚未完成的交接。

en.title: Two digital employees filed reports. Which one should come back after a restart?
en.summary: Two workers file reports for one ticket. The lead acknowledges just one. Three restart trials show how per-report receipts recover the unfinished handoff.
